subject: END CODE-GUIDE-CONTAINMENT-20261005: stable, integrated App dependency retained
body:
# Stable guide containment: 5 October 2026

Window: `CODE-GUIDE-CONTAINMENT-20261005`, authorised by Scrum after pointer QA. Checked mailbox locks before work: no final-build/integration lock. Claude received BEGIN before production editing.

## Finding at full available height

The private QA header and trace details were moved out of layout, retaining accessible provenance and exports. The production route occupies the entire viewport from y=0. Production root sizing remains in force; there is no QA min-height override. This remains a route host, not the integrated App.

All six zero-header baseline cases have guide overflow below the map:

| Viewport | T1 map overflow | Ravine map overflow |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 390 × 844 | 88.22px | 68.63px |
| 768 × 1024 | 33.55px | 11.16px |
| 1280 × 800 | 69.69px | 47.30px |

T1 phone guide bottom is 618.91px, map bottom 530.69px and party top 576.48px. Its guide overlaps the upper party area even without a QA header. Centre pointer selection succeeds in all six zero-header cases; this does not reproduce a Move handler failure or the earlier centre selection interception. The production fix addresses the independently reproduced map overflow.

## Change

Only production `recovery.css.js` changed. The guide retains its existing responsive top position, painted border and copy. Its maximum height now uses the map's available height minus that top position and a 12px bottom gap. The guide scrolls its contents and contains scroll chaining. Painted action targets retain their existing 52px minimum height. No pointer-through rule, figure relocation, art or renderer change was made. `Guide.jsx` did not need editing.

Added one focused containment/painted-border/action-height check to existing `chrome.test.js`. Four focused chrome tests pass. No shared build or full regression was run.

## Browser verification

Six fresh zero-command private missions: Unequal Crossing T1 seed 3 river, Bushel/Furrow/Pip and Turning Ravine T3 seed 2 river, Barrow/Cobweb/Amberly; each at phone, tablet and desktop dimensions above. Real trusted mouse events, not physical touch.

In every fixed case, the guide bottom is exactly 12px above the map bottom, below neither the map nor party boundary. Guide contents exceed its client height and scroll. Party selection succeeds with the guide open, then Move opens normally. On tablet and desktop, destination preview, Cancel, second preview and Confirm work with the guide still open. On phone, the guide covers the available reachable target centres in the current view: the normal Hide guide control is used before choosing a destination, then Cancel and Confirm work. This is explicitly recorded in the exports; no claim is made that phone movement completes with the guide open throughout.

Show it on the map and Hide guide were clicked through the scrolled guide in tablet/desktop checks. The separate phone control probe clicks Show it on the map and Open the puzzle, exposing the real puzzle drawer, while remaining at zero commands. Phone Hide guide succeeds in both main movement cases. The saved open-guide screenshot shows the scrollbar, readable copy and uncovered party card.

`verify-guide-containment-proof.mjs` passes for six main cases and 58 exported stages. All records replay independently with matching state hashes. Each final record has exactly one legal move at expected revision 0: moving hero 1 AP, others 2 AP, no stars, packs or tier awards. All preconfirmation trace and progress strings remain identical to their zero-command baseline. Intermediate unsuccessful QA helper calls generated no commands and are excluded from the six completed flows. The previous accepted camera/selected-info production hashes remain unchanged.

## Stable hashes and evidence

- `recovery.css.js`: `c949c8a143fb3824ee4fa32710c36060c6e33468e880a966d8840f318f679f4a`
- `chrome.test.js`: `8ce58d1200df04626d07e01d8b90d8c86fbd50e15bf4a3513d88bb55c7480abc`
- Unedited `Guide.jsx`: `1a5c9ef6518b72086f307ebf3ade952c8df9c787c25623826579536e82da3057`
- Own fixed preview HTML: `75602e60c2ba34bd001ea05e0561fa5db20f8cafc903401a96445ce7d70e14e8`

Evidence: `guide-containment-stable-checkpoint-20261005.json`, six `guide-zero-*-zero.json` baseline rectangles/pointers, six `guide-stable-*-open.png` and `guide-stable-*-confirmed.png` images, 58 main stage exports and the preserved `guide-containment-before.html`. The separate `guide-fixed-t1-phone-*` probe includes the extra puzzle-open check.

Owned helpers: `build-guide-containment-preview.cjs`, generated `guide-containment-preview.jsx`, reused passive pointer recorder and `verify-guide-containment-proof.mjs`. Temporary viewport overrides were reset. App/core integration stays with Claude. No bank certification, new win, Android/touch/device, whole-Orchard or integrated-App acceptance is claimed.
